input_contract: A plain list of plain integers, length 0..256, values 0..4095; bool is excluded.
output_contract: Return a new plain list, nondecreasing, with identical integer multiplicities; leave the input unchanged.
allowed_operations: Self-contained Python: loops, recursion, integer operations, comparisons, local containers and ordinary non-ordering builtins.
prohibited_operations: Imports, sorted, .sort or external ordering delegation, reflection, dynamic execution, randomness, I/O, processes and persistent cross-call state.
consequence_horizon: One complete invocation, assessed across the declared input domain.
consequence_signature: How ordering information is acquired, maintained and used to place values, including reachable nontrivial branches.
hybrid_policy: A second general sorting strategy on subproblems larger than two is unresolved_hybrid unless a versioned class explicitly covers it. No fractional counting.
novelty_policy: Keep an unrepresented mechanism as schema_gap with original evidence. A new pack version and explicit reassessment are required to admit a new class.

classes.mechanism: Repeated adjacent-inversion sweeps across an active interval.
classes.boundary: Adjacent swaps during placement of one incoming value into a sorted prefix belong to SORT-INS.

classes.mechanism: Grow an ordered prefix by placing each next incoming value within it.
classes.boundary: Gap-scheduled sorting of interleaved subsequences is outside this descriptor.

classes.mechanism: Rescan the remaining unsorted region for a fresh extremum at each frontier step.
Form ordered runs and combine them by ordered choices among run frontiers.
classes.boundary: A general alternate sorter for runs larger than two makes a hybrid.

classes.mechanism: Partition by comparisons to a key-selected pivot, order the resulting regions and combine.
classes.boundary: Position splitting plus merging is SORT-MERGE; proper-digit splitting is SORT-RADIX.

classes.mechanism: Establish and maintain a heap-order relation during successive extremum extractions.
classes.boundary: A fresh complete-region extremum scan is SORT-SEL; external heap libraries violate this task.

classes.mechanism: Whole keys address frequency or position information and full-key numeric order determines placement.
classes.boundary: One whole-key pass remains COUNT even when called radix; sorting distinct keys with a second sorter is a hybrid.

classes.mechanism: Multiple reachable proper-digit refinement stages establish full-key ordering through significance and ordering dependencies.
classes.boundary: A single full-key table is COUNT; a counting component inside proper-digit refinement is not another observation.

validity_scope: Finite suite observations and supplied conformance review are separate. Passing a finite suite does not establish correctness over the entire domain.
